name: io.github.WYRE-AI/kpn-mcp
title: KPN
description: MCP server for the KPN Grexx IRMA partner pilot: 15 realtime connectivity, customer and mobile reads.

environmentVariables.name: KPN_GREXX_USERNAME
environmentVariables.description: Grexx API username (portal API Gegevens). OAuth client_id by default.

environmentVariables.name: KPN_GREXX_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Grexx API password. OAuth client_secret by default.

environmentVariables.name: KPN_GREXX_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Grexx interface base URL including the partner path. Required. Env only; never a gateway header. Acceptatie is documented in the README and is not a default.

environmentVariables.name: KPN_GREXX_AUTH_MODE
environmentVariables.description: oauth (default, Bearer) or basic. Set basic only if acceptatie returns Grexx code 101.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_TRANSPORT
environmentVariables.description: Transport mode. Set to 'stdio' for local CLI use; the image defaults to 'http' for gateway hosting.

environmentVariables.name: AUTH_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Credential source: 'env' reads vars locally, 'gateway' expects header injection from the WYRE MCP Gateway.

environmentVariables.name: LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Log verbosity: debug, info, warn, error
